newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-ENQVIST IN DOUBT FOR WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ENQVIST IN DOUBT FOR WIMBLEDON.

text.p: Sweden's Thomas Enqvist, who pulled out of the French Open with a foot injury, said on Saturday he was in doubt for Wimbledon next month.
Enqvist, the world number nine, pulled out of the Paris tournament which starts on Monday after a freak accident during a training session in Monte Carlo two weeks ago.
"I tripped on a sports bag on the side of the court and got my foot caught. Two tendons went but I thought it was even worse," he said.
Enqvist tried out the left foot during this week's World Team Cup in Germany.
"During that match I decided not to go to Paris. I knew I needed a match to test it out. When I go flat out it hurts and the foot swells up," he said.
"I don't know about Wimbledon. I'm going to get some treatment but I won't enter if I'm not completely fit," he added.
